department: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

deadline.value: Apply by December 15, 2026, 11:59 pm Pacific; scores, letters and transcripts by January 3.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Not stated on the official pages checked.

funding.value: Admitted students are considered for department funding, but fellowships are highly competitive and research posts depend on individual faculty grants.
funding.quote: The departmental fellowships are highly competitive and are typically awarded only to the most highly recruited applicants. | Each faculty member determines if he/she has the funding available

entry_route.value: A master's is not needed; bachelor's-only admits complete the UCLA M.S. on the way to the Ph.D.
entry_route.quote: Applicants interested in a Ph.D. in Electrical and Computer Engineering are not required to have completed the master's degree in order to be considered for admission. | Applicants currently finishing a B.S. or an M.S. may apply for the Ph.D.
